164  def __callback_joint_states(self, msg):
165  if not self.joint_limits:
166  return
167 
168  current_out_of_bounds_state = False
169  # Add a small offset during limit checking to avoid flaky out of bound state
170  delta = 0.04 # Corresponds to about 2 deg which is the diff between hardware and software limits for the Ned3
171  if not self.hardware_status.calibration_in_progress and not self.hardware_status.calibration_needed:
172  for joint_name, joint_pose in zip(msg.name, msg.position):
173  if (joint_name in self.joint_limits and not (self.joint_limits[joint_name].min - delta <= joint_pose <=
174  self.joint_limits[joint_name].max + delta)):
175  current_out_of_bounds_state = True
176  break
177 
178  if self.out_of_bounds != current_out_of_bounds_state:
179  self.out_of_bounds = current_out_of_bounds_state
180  self.__robot_status_handler.advertise_warning()
181 
182  def read_joint_limits(self):
183  tries = 0
184  while not rospy.is_shutdown() and tries < 10:
185  try:
186  rospy.wait_for_service('/niryo_robot_arm_commander/get_joints_limit', timeout=5)
187  joint_limits_service = rospy.ServiceProxy('/niryo_robot_arm_commander/get_joints_limit', GetJointLimits)
188  self.joint_limits = {
189  joint_limit.name: joint_limit
190  for joint_limit in joint_limits_service.call().joint_limits
191  }
192  return
193  except rospy.ROSException:
194  rospy.logwarn("Waiting for '/niryo_robot_arm_commander/get_joints_limit' service")
195  except rospy.ServiceException as e:
196  rospy.logerr("Service call to get_joints_limit failed: %s" % e)
197  tries += 1
